claims.sentence: Secondary outcome measures include: * adverse events, * Epworth Sleepiness Scale (ESS), * Symptoms of Nocturnal Obstruction and Related Events (SNORE-25), * patient-reported satisfaction, * CGI-Improvement, * the rate of subjects re-selecting the treatment, and * the rate of subjects recommending the treatment. and * changes in sleep study metrics (i.e., AHI, ODI, mean arterial saturation, and Time\<90%),
